raw_segments.text: I affirm and can prove that on the 20th of October A.D., a date of 15 years back, Edward
Fairfax Rochester of Thornfield Hall in the county of and a Ferndian manor in Shire, England
was married to my sister, Bertha Antonetta Mason, daughter of Jonas Mason, merchant
and of Antonetta his wife, a creole at Church, Spanish Town, Jamaica.
The record of the marriage will be found in the register of that church.
A copy of it is now in my possession.
